title: Chapter 202
text:
Including Hao Tian, Han Xiao had contacted a few professional players in the Northern Continent and sent them out for missions.

He gave the pro player his phone number and email. After completing the mission, he had to send all the details over. Only then would the mission be considered complete. This way, he could pass his own mission judgment. If there was a mission item that he needed to give to Hannes, he would have to personally take a plane to get it.

However, compared to doing it himself, it saved him a lot of time. He could command the strong players to help him complete the mission and reap the benefits.

Among the professional players who came to accept the mission, there were many strong players from his previous life, and Hao Tian was one of the best. Although Han Xiao had high hopes for Hao Tian, since he said that he would only treat him differently after he completed the mission, he was not in a hurry.

In the Northern Continent, Han Technician rushed to the Novice Village and spent most of his time on the road. During the journey, Han Xiao used the max level [Precision Enhancement Modification] to upgrade his equipment, and its attributes increased slightly. He also tried to create the three pieces of equipment that he had chosen, and the results were satisfactory.

The first time he created it, the quality was blue. After more practice, there was a chance for him to reach purple equipment.

The players at level 19 had already appeared, and with Han Xiao's current efficiency, he could complete all the Novice Villages in the Northern Continent before the first player advanced.

As for the Andrea Continent, Han Xiao felt that it was too late, but he did not want to go to Andrea anyway. That was the Germinal Organization's base camp, a dangerous place. Furthermore, the players were forced to leave the Novice Village by the Germinal Organization. To him, the risks were far greater than the benefits.

At this time, in the Blue Star section of the forum, the Northern Continent players were the happiest, and the Andrea players were the second most excited. In their opinion, after Black Phantom finished running through the Northern Continent, it would be their turn next.

"This is awkward." Han Xiao was helpless.

…

The weather in the Northern Continent was cold, and the main terrain was snowy plains and icebergs. Thin snow floated in the air, and the towering mountains in the distance were shrouded in clouds. The boundary between the dark green mountains and the snow was clear.

The third Novice Village was called Frost Pine Village. It was located in a frozen forest valley. The vast expanse of white forest was filled with ferocious northern beasts.

The plane landed outside the forest. Han Xiao trekked through the forest with his electromagnetic hovershoes and headed towards Frost Pine Town according to the radar. The distant roars of beasts could be heard from time to time, reminding Han Xiao that there were many beasts in the Northern Continent, and there was no lack of high-level beasts.

"I remember there's an ice field where the Ice Claw Bears are high-level monsters. They're between Level 53 and Level 56, and they're not Elites or Bosses. I can get [Lethal Shot] there," Han Xiao thought to himself.

That ice field was a bit far, so Han Xiao planned to go there after he finished running the Novice Village.

While looking at the map, he noticed something else. The Overmera family's territory was not far from Frost Pine Town.

Not long after, Frost Pine Town appeared in his line of sight. Han Xiao composed himself, slowed down his pace, and walked over.

…

In the forest a hundred meters away from Frost Pine Town, a dozen people were sitting in a circle. They were all wearing combat suits, guns, and daggers. They were organizing their equipment.

They were a combat team from the Overmera. They were ordered to capture some Inhumans in Frost Pine Town and bring them back for research.

Captain Keaton had a ferocious look on his face. He held a handmade cigarette in his mouth and pulled the bolt of his gun. He said in a rough voice, "The battle plan is clear. Don't make any mistakes!"

"Don't worry. It's just a group of Inhumans.

"If they dare to resist …" Keaton patted the grenades on his waist. "Don't be stingy with these little things. Blast them into charcoal."

Everyone laughed.

"Also, these Inhumans look no different from normal people. Don't catch the wrong people." Keaton looked at his watch and asked everyone to stand up. "Organize your equipment. Follow my signal."

At this time, a figure walked past on a small path outside the forest. One of the team members pointed and whispered, "Captain, there's a passerby there. Is he an Inhuman?"

"I think so. There are many beasts in this forest. Only Inhumans would move alone."

"Catch this lone Inhuman, and we'll complete the mission."

Everyone was eager to try.

But after waiting for a few seconds, they realized that their captain didn't respond. They turned around and were shocked.

The ferocious Keaton's face was now pale with fear. His lips were trembling unnaturally, and his cigarette fell to the ground.

"What's wrong?" One of the team members didn't understand.

Keaton's throat moved up and down. He hurriedly said, "Cancel the plan. Leave this place immediately!"

"Why?" Everyone was shocked.

"That's not an Inhuman!" Keaton said angrily. "He — he's Black Phantom! He just had a conflict with the family not long ago! "

Black Phantom!

Everyone was shocked. They looked at the road to confirm, but they realized that the road was empty. The figure had disappeared without them knowing.

Then, they heard an unfamiliar voice coming from behind them.

"I think I heard you call me."

Everyone froze and turned around mechanically. A figure in black was standing behind Keaton, looking at them curiously.

A chill ran down their spines.

Keaton's hair stood on end. He didn't notice how Han Xiao got behind him. The sound just now was like thunder to him. He was so scared that his heart twitched. It was so cold, but he was so nervous that he was sweating.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. He had felt the presence of people from afar. These armed men were so nervous in front of him. They probably knew who he was and didn't have good intentions.

"Are you going to say it yourself, or do you want me to help you? You can try lying. " Han Xiao curled his finger. Seven scattered blades suddenly flew out from the pockets on his waist and legs. They floated in the air and aimed at the vital parts of Keaton's body.

Compound Compounded Compounded Split Magnetic Chain Split Blade, blue quality, attack power 34-92, Super equipment. The slashing power of the blades depends on the amount of energy used. It can be shaped into all kinds of weapon shapes, and its attack speed is very high. The equipment comes with the skill [Revolving Slash]. All the blades cut like a clown throwing a ball. It can cause high speed and high damage. Before level 60, it can be considered a melee weapon.

In the eyes of the players, this thing can be considered a godly weapon in the early game. Han Xiao had spent millions of experience to get this blueprint.

The cold light in front of Keaton made his scalp numb. He quickly told Han Xiao the identity of the team and the mission, not daring to hide anything.

They were from Overmera. Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He knew why these people were afraid of him. Last time in Green Valley Town, he helped Lu Cheng attack Overmera's territory and formed a grudge with Overmera. However, he saw rumors on the Dark Net that Overmera wanted to take revenge on Lu Cheng, but they didn't mention anything about him.

I should be enemies with them. Are they afraid of me?

Han Xiao suddenly became interested. He put away the Compounded Split Magnetic Chain Split Blades and said, "Go back and tell your leader that I will visit him soon."

Keaton's tense nerves relaxed. He didn't dare to turn around and look at Han Xiao. He quickly ran away, and his team members quickly followed.

After running for a few hundred meters, Keaton stopped. He turned around and confirmed that Black Phantom was not chasing him. He then let out a long sigh of relief. He was sweating like he was just fished out of water. His heart was still beating violently.

"Captain, what do we do?" Everyone still had fear on their faces.

"Let's go back and tell the leaders about this." Keaton gulped.

…

"Black Phantom came to the North Continent and wants to 'visit' us?"

The leader of Overmera, Delot, opened his eyes wide like an angry bear. He yelled, "We didn't even look for him, and he dares to come to us first. He doesn't respect us at all. I'm going to kill him!"

The three-headed leader, Se Qi, was a Sharnuk. He had dark brown skin and a muscular body. He said in a muffled voice, "Don't be impulsive. He's not someone to be trifled with. He dares to come to us alone, so he must be fearless."

Delot stared at him. "Xiao Jin, what do you think?"

Xiao Jin adjusted his monocle and said calmly, "He only said that he wants to visit. If he wants to deal with us, he doesn't need to inform us. We can contact him first and see his attitude. Maybe Black Phantom doesn't plan to do anything."
